scope: Playback timing audit of all 18 full-score core-pass exports; no recognition changes
cause_notes: case-037: removing palm mute only in an in-memory reference probe removes all timing differences
case-039: removing hammer/pull and slide links only in an in-memory reference probe removes all timing differences
case-064 and case-071: removing brush offsets only in an in-memory reference probe removes attack differences; palm mute also contributes release differences
case-046: missing 120->165->120 tempo sequence changes generated playback length from reference 202s to exported 208s
case-081: first attack difference at bar 7 is an upper mordent; removing ornaments in an in-memory reference probe moves the first difference later but does not make the full score pass
Probes do not modify GP files and never replace the original reference for pass/fail results
